description: This file implements the MediaPipelineCapabilities class and related factory functions for media pipeline capabilities, including methods to check supported MIME types and create capabilities objects, with logging and exception handling.

classes.name: MediaPipelineCapabilities
classes.description: Implements media pipeline capabilities, including supported MIME types and MIME type support checks, using a factory for GStreamer capabilities.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to a media pipeline capabilities factory, with exception handling and logging.

methods.name: createMediaPipelineCapabilities
methods.description: Creates and returns a unique pointer to a media pipeline capabilities object, using a GStreamer capabilities factory, with exception handling and logging.

methods.name: MediaPipelineCapabilities::MediaPipelineCapabilities
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the capabilities object with a GStreamer capabilities factory and throws if creation fails.

methods.name: getSupportedMimeTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of supported MIME types for a given media source type.

methods.name: isMimeTypeSupported
methods.description: Checks if a specific MIME type is supported.
